name: To-do card
description: A white to-do card drops into the top band over the speaker: a small mono title and a 0/2 counter, then two or three rows with rounded checkboxes. 'Done' rows tick on their word (orange box, white check, the text struck through and greyed, the counter goes up); a 'next' row lights up instead with a soft orange band, a pulse, an orange border on its box and an arrow nudging at it.
use_when: A call to action or a sequence phrased as a checklist: 'if you've done X, do Y next', steps you finished and the one left, what to do after watching.

items.help: [{text, at, next, checked}] text <= 30 characters; at = seconds from the scene start; next: true lights the row instead of ticking it; checked: true starts it ticked
